objective: Original unrestricted Tuscan-2(11): eleven permutations of the same eleven symbols with all 110 linear distance-one ordered events distinct and all 99 linear distance-two ordered events distinct. No wraparound, Latin-column, fixed row or fixed symbol assumption.

source_definition.literal_scope: S2 LF5-7; the older HOLD text is superseded prospectively by contract-addendum-2.

method: Single-threaded bounded simulated annealing; each restart independently shuffles all eleven rows, and every proposal swaps two entries within an existing row. Thus every candidate is an actual permutation array and no column, cyclic, row-order, automorphism or orientation restriction is imposed. For each distance separately, the score is the sum over ordered pairs of count*(count-1)/2. Score zero is equivalent to both layers having distinct events; at distance one, 110 distinct events exhaust all 110 ordered pairs of distinct symbols. Proposals are biased toward a repeated event but unrestricted random swaps also occur. An independent Python checker reconstructs event lists from the actual saved rows and compares its counts with reported search metrics.
verification: Both saved actual arrays were checked independently by rebuilding and grouping all events from the rows; both are 11 permutations, not witnesses, with no metric mismatch. The checker includes every repeated pair, one-based row/column occurrences, and missing pairs. The result is a concrete validated near-candidate, not a successful construction.
limits: A stochastic search failure proves neither nonexistence nor a lower bound. The code's acceptance temperatures are heuristic. No theorem, proof, formal certification, independent-model review, novelty or current-world source-status conclusion follows. Earlier historical quarantined results are not used as premises; current local computation is permitted prospectively by the owner direction.
continuation: Continue with an independently formulated exact constraint search and/or improved guided search on the same original row domain; verify every new candidate with the independent checker. No model API, nested agent, publication, Git mutation, deletion or infrastructure action.
